sources.snippet: 🍳 Gemma 4 Multimodal Recipe & Food Dataset A balanced, high-density multimodal dataset curated specifically for fine-tuning compact vision-language models (such as gemma-4-e2b-it) for visual food recognition, recipe generation, and dietary recommendation.
